[https://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/7627/qhlan-2022-need-a-ride Need a ride] }} After three long covid pestered years, '''QHLAN''' returned to Sweden, after a brief visit to [[QHLAN2019|Denmark in 2019]]. This time in the huge dance studio [https://goo.gl/maps/LzV8vF9jakfb3wi89 Epic Studios] owned by old school [[Clan 9]] legend {{player|Sniket|flag=se}}. Starting early sunday, we say players battling it out in [[QHLAN2022/2on2|2on2]], [[QHLAN2022/1on1|1on1]] and [[QHLAN2022/4on4|4on4]], one day per tournament. A total of 89 players attended (including crew), of which many were international mainly from the US, aswell as various European counties. QHLAN 2022 was streamed live at [http://twitch.tv/TastySpleenTV TastyspleenTV]. ===Broadcast Talent=== {{Box|start|padding=1em}} '''Hosts:''' * {{player|BouvToTheMax|flag=us}} * {{player|LethalWiz|flag=se}} * {{player|Sniket|flag=se}} {{Box|break|padding=1em}} '''Casters:''' * {{player|Andeh|flag=se}} * {{player|Jehar|flag=us}} {{Box|break|padding=1em}} '''Guest Casters:''' * {{player|Feffe|flag=se|link=}} * {{player|LethalWiz|flag=se|link=}} * {{player|Peppe|flag=se|link=}} * {{player|LocKtar|flag=se|link=}} * {{player|Rio|flag=se|link=}} * {{player|BouvToTheMax|flag=us}} {{Box|break|padding=1em}} '''Production:''' * {{player|Jehar|flag=us}} * {{player|RottenRose|flag=us}} * {{player|GMT|flag=gb}} * {{player|BouvToTheMax|flag=us}} {{Box|end}} ==Prize Pool== The '''28 952 SEK''' crowdfunded prize pool will be spread among the players as seen below.
